messages:
tess: quick sync after the postmortem - we keep seeing fast ramps and silent config drift. propose a compact auto-rollback policy in rollout-service + short runbook.

maria: yes. v1 scope: rollout-service flags only. small policy + UI indicators.

jin: policy sketch: auto_rollback=true, rollback_if: error_rate>4% sustained 2 windows, p95>800ms, default blast_radius=10%, ramp_steps [0.5,2,10], cooldown 30m.

samir: ops: ensure rollback events land in incidents and include the snapshot. @ops-bot create tracking ticket.

ops-bot: created INF-5200 to add rollback_event with rollback.metrics to incident timeline.

tess: ownership: maria -> policy + UI (8d), jin -> telemetry+alerts (4d), samir -> infra checks (2d), i'll update runbook (1d).

maria: i'll open a draft PR today. adding a small banner when a flag is under auto control.

jin: will emit flag_id, step, region labels and push rollback snapshots to incidents.

samir: i'll confirm paging quotas and idempotency for rollback API.

tess: goal: reduce manual rollback median to <2m and cap default blast radius at 10%. check-in next Thu. add blockers to INF-5200. :rocket:
